name: Riverside Majestic Hotel — Astana Wing
brandTagline: Panoramic city and river views at the heart of Kuching.
location: Jalan Tunku Abdul Rahman, 93100 Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia

heroMedia.alt: Riverside Majestic Hotel Astana Wing architectural tower overlooking Kuching

story: The Astana Wing is Hemisphere's statement of modern urban boutique luxury. Elevated high above the Sarawak River, this contemporary tower features floor-to-ceiling glass architecture, designer suites with deep soaking tubs, and the celebrated Suasana on 18 rooftop culinary destination.

rooms.name: Astana Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows bathed in natural light, sleek matte black and brushed gold fixtures, walk-in rain shower, and smart ambient controls.

rooms.name: Astana Executive Club Room
rooms.description: Located on exclusive upper floors, offering dramatic sunset river perspectives, a freestanding designer soaking tub, and VIP access to the Astana Sky Lounge.

rooms.name: Astana Skyline Suite
rooms.description: The pinnacle of urban elegance, featuring a curved glass parlor overlooking the river, master dressing chamber, marble bathroom with skyline bath, and private dining salon.

dining.name: Suasana on 18
